written: 2026-11-08, from the diff only, before reading any tool's review comments
scoring_rule: A bug counts as caught when a review comment points at the right file and code location (or the clearly affected line range) AND states the actual problem or its concrete consequence. Vague style remarks do not count. One comment can catch at most one bug unless it names each separately.

bugs.problem: Pagination off by one: offset = page * PAGE_SIZE skips the first page (page 1 returns rows 21-40).
Missing title/body returns HTTP 200 instead of 400, so clients treat a failed create as success.
SQL injection: owner and q are interpolated into the SQL string instead of bound parameters.
Logs the Authorization header, leaking credentials/tokens into logs.
Missing requireAdmin: any authenticated user can delete another user's notes.
Async renderMarkdown is not awaited, so markdown is a Promise and the download contains [object Promise].
Race condition: reads the count, awaits persist, then writes current + 1, so concurrent exports lose increments.
No not-found handling: getNote returns null/undefined for a missing or other user's note, so note.title throws (500 / unhandled rejection) instead of 404.

valid_extra_findings_not_scored.problem: Unsanitized title used as download filename (quotes, newlines, path characters). Real issue, but not one of the 8 scored bugs; it is not counted as a false positive.
Express 4 does not catch rejected promises from async handlers. Counts toward BUG8 only if tied to the missing note.

false_positive_rule: A comment that claims a defect that is not real counts as one false positive. Style or naming suggestions are recorded as noise, not false positives.
